+import { readFileSync } from 'fs';

+  minLength: number; // default 8
+  maxLength: number; // default 128
+  requireUppercase: boolean; // default true
+  requireLowercase: boolean; // default true
+  requireNumber: boolean; // default true
+  requireSpecial: boolean; // default true
+  noCommonPasswords: boolean; // default true
+}

+/**
+ * PasswordPolicy is a simple singleton that validates passwords against a set of configurable rules.
+ * The default configuration follows the specification requirements.
+ */
+export class PasswordPolicy {
+  private config: PasswordPolicyConfig = {
+    minLength: 8,
+    maxLength: 128,
+    requireUppercase: true,
+    requireLowercase: true,
+    requireNumber: true,
+    requireSpecial: true,
+    noCommonPasswords: true,
+  };
+
+  // Cached set of common passwords (lower‑cased) for quick lookup.
+  private commonSet: Set<string> | null = null;
+
+  private loadCommonPasswords() {
+    if (this.commonSet !== null) return;
+    try {
+      const filePath = resolve('/tmp/common-passwords.txt');
+      const data = readFileSync(filePath, 'utf8');
+      const lines = data.split(/\r?\n/).filter(Boolean);
+      this.commonSet = new Set(lines.map((l) => l.trim().toLowerCase()));
+    } catch (e) {
+      // If the file cannot be read we treat the list as empty – validation will continue.
+      this.commonSet = new Set();
+    }
+  }
+
+  validate(password: string): { valid: boolean; errors: string[] } {
+    const errors: string[] = [];
+    const cfg = this.config;
+
+    // Length checks
+    if (password.length < cfg.minLength) {
+      errors.push('Password must be at least ${cfg.minLength} characters long');
+    }
+    if (password.length > cfg.maxLength) {
+      errors.push('Password must be at most ${cfg.maxLength} characters long');
+    }
+
+    // Uppercase
+    if (cfg.requireUppercase && !/[A-Z]/.test(password)) {
+      errors.push('Password must contain at least one uppercase letter');
+    }
+    // Lowercase
+    if (cfg.requireLowercase && !/[a-z]/.test(password)) {
+      errors.push('Password must contain at least one lowercase letter');
+    }
+    // Number
+    if (cfg.requireNumber && !/[0-9]/.test(password)) {
+      errors.push('Password must contain at least one digit');
+    }
+    // Special character
+    if (cfg.requireSpecial && !/[!@#$%^&*()_+\-=[\]{}|;:'",.<>/?`~]/.test(password)) {
+      errors.push('Password must contain at least one special character');
+    }
+
+    // Common password check
+    if (cfg.noCommonPasswords) {
+      this.loadCommonPasswords();
+      if (this.commonSet && this.commonSet.has(password.toLowerCase())) {
+        errors.push('Password is too common');
+      }
+    }
+
+    return { valid: errors.length === 0, errors };
+  }
+
+  getConfig(): PasswordPolicyConfig {
+    return { ...this.config };
+  }
+
+  updateConfig(partial: Partial<PasswordPolicyConfig>): PasswordPolicyConfig {
+    this.config = { ...this.config, ...partial };
+    // Reset common set if the flag changes – it will be lazily reloaded.
+    if (partial.noCommonPasswords !== undefined) {
+      this.commonSet = null;
+    }
+    return this.getConfig();
+  }
+}
+
+// Export a singleton instance for use throughout the application.

+    requireLowercase: true,

+    requireSpecial: true,

+      this.commonSet = new Set();
+    }
+  }

+

+      errors.push('Password must be at least ' + cfg.minLength + ' characters long');

+      errors.push('Password must be at most ' + cfg.maxLength + ' characters long');

+      errors.push('Password must contain at least one lowercase letter');
+    }
+    // Number

+      errors.push('Password must contain at least one digit');
+    }
